rationale: The DEV-01..12 / AI-01..11 policy reuses the existing task-scope and behavior-governance path. DEV-12 adds FA3/CFA3 development main-task continuity: newly introduced rules and parallel task/PR monitoring remain constraints or dependencies of the active main task and cannot silently reassign it. This creates no provider, runner, daemon, scheduler, hardware path, host lease, driver, service, credential flow, product runtime capability, or physical Current Host PASS. Agent Workload Current Host status remains governed separately; historical physical evidence is not reused.
